summary: Ares Capital Corporation filed an 8-K under Items 2.02 and 8.01 to disclose its Q1 2026 financial results and declare a quarterly dividend of $0.48 per share. The filing reports GAAP net income of $92M ($0.13/share) and Core EPS of $0.47, with net investment income of $398M. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special situation is announced. This is a routine earnings and dividend declaration, not a special situation.
